text:
Fixed `parse_metadata_block` in `registry/model.py:251` to use the same well-formed-pair search (`_metadata_bounds`) that `upsert_metadata_block` already relies on, instead of naively splitting on the first BEGIN/first END. This means:

- A quoted, unfinished example block (BEGIN with no END) anywhere in the body — before or after the real block — no longer leaks fields (e.g. `parent`) into the parsed result.
- If no complete BEGIN/END pair exists at all, it now correctly returns `{}` (no metadata) instead of scavenging a partial/incomplete block.
- Both consumers (`task_from_metadata` used by `providers/github.py`, and the direct calls in `providers/local.py`) get this fix for free since they all go through `parse_metadata_block`.

Added regression coverage in `tests/test_model.py` (7 tests, all passing) covering: leading/trailing unfinished examples, no-block and only-unfinished-block cases, reader/writer agreement, preservation of surrounding human text on update, and that repeated evidence/reproduction entries with commas still round-trip correctly.
